title: Eventful Platform
description: Full-stack event ticketing platform with QR code generation, Paystack payment integration, attendee management, analytics dashboard, and email notifications. Deployed on AWS EC2.

title: Wallet Service
description: Secure wallet service with Paystack deposit integration, wallet-to-wallet transfers, Google OAuth authentication, API key management, and comprehensive Swagger documentation. Deployed on Azure with CI/CD.

title: SchoolBase Backend API
description: Multi-platform educational portal API with authentication, tenant-specific configurations, and role-based access control. Open source contribution during HNG Internship.

title: GitHub Issue Monitor
description: Real-time monitoring tool for tracking GitHub repository activities, issues, pull requests, and commits with Telegram bot integration for instant notifications.

title: Restaurant Chatbot
description: Intelligent chatbot for restaurant order management with conversational UI, menu browsing, and order tracking capabilities.

title: Birthday Reminder App
description: Birthday management application with full CRUD operations for birthday records, automated reminders, and notification scheduling.

title: Insighta Labs+ Backend
description: Secure profile-intelligence API serving a CLI, a web portal, and direct API consumers from one data and permission model. GitHub OAuth + PKCE, role-based access control, CSV export, and a full security middleware stack (helmet, CORS, rate-limit, CSRF). Deployed on AWS App Runner. HNG Stage 3.

title: Insighta Labs+ Web Portal
description: Next.js 15 portal for the Insighta platform. Single-origin via server rewrites so http-only cookies and CSRF work without cross-domain workarounds, role-aware UI, and automatic token refresh on 401. HNG Stage 3.

title: Insighta CLI
description: Globally installable terminal client for the Insighta platform. Logs in with GitHub OAuth + PKCE straight from the shell via a one-shot loopback server, stores tokens at 0600, and exports profiles as CSV. HNG Stage 3.

title: FlowBrand Strategy Service
description: NestJS microservice that turns a marketing brief into a full strategy tree (strategy → funnel stages → tasks) using Claude, persisted in a single database transaction. JWT auth guard, per-user daily rate limit, and Swagger docs. Deployed on AWS. HNG Stage 5.

title: Append-Only Event Store
description: A key-value event store where the log file is the database: append-only writes, an in-memory byte-offset index for O(1) reads, and replay-based crash recovery that rebuilds the index on restart — the same WAL trick Postgres and SQLite use.

title: Intelligence Query Engine
description: Demographic query platform with a rule-based natural-language parser that turns plain English like "young males from nigeria" into structured database filters — no LLM, just deterministic regex rules. Validated end-to-end with Playwright. HNG Stage 2.

title: Profile Classification System
description: Full-stack app that classifies a name's likely gender, age group, and nationality using three external APIs in parallel for sub-second responses, with full idempotency to prevent duplicates and time-ordered UUIDv7 IDs. HNG Stage 1.

title: Gender Classifier API
description: Focused API that classifies names by gender via Genderize.io with the production concerns handled: Zod validation, in-memory caching, rate limiting, request timeouts, structured logging, Swagger docs, and full Jest/Supertest coverage.

title: HNG Backend Portfolio
description: A focused, single-page portfolio of my backend work during the HNG internship — profile, every HNG project, skills backed by evidence, a featured deep dive, and an honest reflection. Built lean with React + Vite + Tailwind, no animation libraries.

title: Schema Pilot
description: An npm package that analyzes Prisma + PostgreSQL migrations for dangerous changes before they reach production — data loss, table locks, missing defaults, unsafe renames — and gives clear, actionable fixes. Runs in CI and exits non-zero on risky migrations.

title: Bandelore
description: A production full-stack comic reading and publishing platform. NestJS + TypeORM + PostgreSQL API with JWT auth and role-based access control, AWS S3 media storage, and a React reader UI with a dual-mode comic reader. 154 tests passing.
